queries.query: Our shared button height changed. Review the search and settings pages, every current consumer, focus and disabled states, and the rendered evidence.
The new modal can overlap a fixed header at a 390px viewport. Review the assembled page, responsive constraint, dismissal, and focus behavior.
A theme token changed the focus outline on form actions. Check the rendered light and dark states and report any untested consumers.
The account form now has loading, empty, validation-error, and success states. Review the browser-rendered layout and whether the action remains reachable.
A global spacing change may clip long translated labels in several screens. Trace affected consumers and compare the real rendered before and after.

Implement a responsive icon-only settings action in our browser app. Keep it understandable on touch and keyboard, preserve focus across the layout change, and verify the assembled narrow and wide states.
Create three new brand directions, choose colors and typography, and propose a visual identity for our landing page.
Audit this repository for missing ARIA attributes and generic WCAG checklist failures outside any specific UI change.
Write a README page explaining how developers import and configure the Button component.
Add cursor pagination to the backend list API and update the database query.
Rename the CSS variable `--color-accent` to `--brand-primary` and update all imports without reviewing rendered pages.
Export the existing SVG glyph as a standalone icon file and document its viewBox; no browser UI or interaction behavior changes.
